prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Pilar, who is cautious about neighborhood rumors but sometimes believes them. Pilar thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I doubt this is actually happening, but apparently Mr. Henderson says the council is fining anyone who leaves their bins out after 8am starting next month. As if they don't have enough rules already!"
text: Mr. Henderson confirmed that the council is officially launching a massive crackdown and will be handing out heavy fines to anyone with a bin on the sidewalk after 8am. It’s absolutely ridiculous how they keep tightening their grip on us!
